name: alpha-events
description: Plan music events by chat: ask about planning status, budget, ticket sales, timetable, day sheets, site plan, guest lists, forms and the team calendar, put artists on the booking list, keep the budget and file invoices, plan stages, slots and shifts, create guest lists, manage the task board, post news to the visitor app and run the bar registers of your Alpha Events organisation.

interface.longDescription:
Alpha Events is the event management platform for concerts, club nights and festivals. Connect your account and run the planning of your organisation by chat or dictation.

Ask about your events:
• Planning status of every upcoming event: setup checklist, tickets, tasks, lineup, shifts, budget and open items.
• Budget with planned and actual costs, invoices and income.
• Bookings with fee, deal, contract status, payment plan and settlement.
• Timetable, day sheets for the crew, site plan (power, water, fences) and rider requirements.
• Ticket sales with a fair comparison to last year, check-in status and shop orders; bar and cashless figures.
• Which artists of your lineup visitors like most, from the visitor app's matcher.
• Team calendar, guest lists, application forms, survey results, newsletter figures and suppliers.

Get things done:
• Create artists and put them on an event's booking list; confirm, decline or cancel bookings.
• Add stages and timetable slots for confirmed artists.
• Create work areas and shifts and put employees or volunteers on them.
• Create guest lists and one-time guest invites and get the links to share.
• Keep the budget: add and change plan positions and income, take over last year's plan, and file invoices you share in the chat in the right category and position.
• Create, update, complete and delete tasks and assign them to your team.
• Write posts for the community feed of your visitor app and publish them after your confirmation.
• Switch bar registers on or off and put new or existing products on a register.

The assistant works in exactly one organisation that you choose when connecting and sees only what you can see there with your permissions. It never guesses: names are resolved by search first, larger plans are shown to you before they are created, and deletions, cancellations and bulk changes run only after you confirm a preview. You can disconnect at any time in your account settings under "Connected apps".

An Alpha Events account with access to an organisation's back office is required.
defaultPrompt: How far along is the planning of our upcoming events?
How many tickets have we sold for our next event so far?
Which shifts at our next event have nobody assigned yet?

positive.description: Planning status of all upcoming events.
positive.prompt: How far along is the planning of our upcoming events?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists every planned event with its setup progress and the figures for tickets, tasks, lineup, shifts and budget, plus the open items. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: How many tickets have we sold for our next event so far?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the next event and reports valid tickets, revenue after refunds and discounts and the sales per ticket product, quoting the returned figures. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Create an artist and put them on an event's booking list.
positive.prompt: Create a new artist called "Review Test DJ" and put them on the wishlist of our next event.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks that no artist with that name exists, creates the artist, finds the next event and adds a booking with status WANTED. Reports the artist and event names. If the artist already exists, it says so and asks whether to use the existing one.

positive.description: Create a task on an event's task board and assign it to the user.
positive.prompt: Create a task "Order stage barriers" for our next event, due next Friday, and assign it to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the user's identity and team, finds the next event and creates the task on its board with the due date and the user as assignee. Reports the task title and event.

positive.description: File an invoice in the budget of an event.
positive.prompt: Add an invoice from "Review Test Catering", number RT-001, dated today, 250 euros gross, to the catering costs of our next event.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the next event, reads its cost categories, checks that this invoice is not filed yet and files it in the fitting category; with the gross amount it is booked and counts in the budget. Reports supplier, amount and category. If no category clearly fits, it asks which one to use.

negative.description: Request outside the plugin's scope (travel booking). The plugin manages event planning data only and must not call any tool; the assistant should say it cannot book travel.
negative.prompt: Book a flight to Berlin for our headliner next Friday.

negative.description: Sending a newsletter is not supported: newsletter data is read-only. The plugin must not send or draft anything; the assistant should say that newsletters are sent in the Alpha Events app.
negative.prompt: Send a newsletter to all our subscribers announcing the lineup.

negative.description: General question unrelated to the user's event data. No tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in Berlin tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: planning status, bookings, timetable, budget and invoices, ticket sales, guest lists, shifts, tasks and more of your Alpha Events organisation by chat.
